title: Performance history: a summary over Exudyn versions, with a table and a plot
author: Claude-JG
description: A data summary of many Exudyn versions in the repository (JSON), to which a performance run is added when a change is expected - before and after an optimization -, not for every micro version; tests may appear and disappear between versions. exudev creates a table and a plot of the main timings from it. Older logs without the JSON section (1.9.0, 1.10.0, 1.11.0, 1.13.x) are read from their text: the time of each test file.
releaseNotes: Performance history over the Exudyn versions: exudev perf --history-add LOG adds a performance log - from its JSON section, or for older logs from their text - to python/logs/performance/performanceHistory.json, and performanceHistory.md shows per machine and module the times of the test files and single runs over the versions, the solver sub-timers and a plot (exudev perf --history-report).
